notes: The initial eight-match cohort predates the supported-group slot correction; the final cohort and retained headless/rendered defense regressions use the fingerprinted implementation.
Both matrix policies field ground combat forces. Air countering and simultaneous unanswerable/answerable raids are exercised in the retained scenario regression.
Advanced matches use SkirmishDefensePolicy; Standard matches use BaseAccessMatches. Both start at seed 4110. Shared seeds do not make asynchronous navigation and crowd avoidance deterministic.
Existing save formats and action records are reused; no persistent strategy-group schema was added.
